title: Ha Tien Du Episode 3: The Sect That Walks on Water
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling
tone: Heroic, melancholic, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: She was not the only one who had learned to command the celestial waters. And the others had very different plans for the mortal world.
concept.story_arc: Arrival of rivals → Water-walking army → Training ground challenge → Flood unleashed → Standoff
concept.emotion: Tension → Fear → Confrontation → Power clash → Dark intent revealed

shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot — a vast lake at dawn, perfectly calm like a mirror. An army of two hundred warriors in dark navy and black armor stands on the surface of the lake — not sinking. Their feet touch the water but do not break it. At their head, a cold beautiful woman in obsidian black Hanfu raises her hand and the entire lake ripples in response. She commands the water. Camera: wide establishing, slow pan across the army. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Pan right — wide establishing, dark water-walking army on mirror lake, 6s
shots.narration: The Celestial Falls were not the only source of water magic. And the Shadow Sect had learned to weaponize it.
shots.sfx: Water rippling, army footsteps on water, ominous war drums, dark orchestral

shots.prompt: Medium shot — she stands alone on a rocky outcrop overlooking the lake. Her ice-blue Hanfu contrasts with the dark army below. She is young, outnumbered, but her expression is calm. She extends one hand toward the lake surface — a ripple of pale blue light meets the dark ripple. The two forces of water collide at the center of the lake in a visible clash of light. Camera: medium shot, focused on her hand extension and the water clash. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Two-shot — her ice-blue light vs dark army's force meeting in the water, 6s
shots.narration: Two hundred warriors who could walk on water. One girl who could make it boil. She chose to make a point.
shots.sfx: Water clash boom, ice cracking, magical energy whoosh, tense strings

shots.prompt: Close-up dramatic — the dark general raises both arms. The entire lake RISES behind her — a wall of water two hundred meters tall, frozen mid-air in the shape of a snarling dragon head. Thousands of liters suspended impossibly. The water army charges forward ON TOP of the frozen water wall. They run up the wall of ice toward her cliff. She stands her ground. Camera: extreme close-up on her face as the water dragon charges. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — her face as the frozen water dragon army charges toward her, 6s
shots.narration: They had come to flood the mortal world below. To wash it clean of what they called 'the unworthy.' She would not let a single drop fall.
shots.sfx: Water roaring, army charge, ice cracking, epic battle drums

shots.prompt: Wide cinematic — she raises BOTH hands. From the cliff behind her, underground rivers EXPLODE upward — not one but TEN columns of boiling celestial water erupting like geysers. The boiling water cuts through the frozen dragon-wall like scissors through silk. Warriors fall. The water wall shatters. Steam and mist fill the entire lake. Camera: wide shot of ten water geysers erupting and shattering the army's formation. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — ten boiling geysers shattering the water dragon wall, epic aerial, 6s
shots.narration: She had learned from the river that remembered everything. And the river had remembered war. It had remembered cruelty. It had remembered what it was like to fight back.
shots.sfx: Boiling water explosion, ice shattering, warriors falling, epic orchestral climax

shots.prompt: Full-body shot — steam clears. She stands on the cliff, steam swirling around her, both hands still raised. Below, the surviving water army retreats across the fractured lake surface. Her expression: fierce, no mercy, tears of fury on her cheeks. She lowers her hands slowly. The steam settles. Camera: full-body, cinematic push in from medium to fierce tearful close-up. 6 seconds. End on her face.
shots.camera: Push in — full body in steam to fierce tearful close-up, 6s
shots.narration: She had won this battle. But the war was just beginning. And they would return with ten times more.
shots.sfx: Steam settling, water dripping, wind, somber epic strings fading

audio.narration: The Celestial Falls were not the only source of water magic. And the Shadow Sect had learned to weaponize it. Two hundred warriors who could walk on water. One girl who could make it boil. She chose to make a point. They had come to flood the mortal world below. To wash it clean of what they called 'the unworthy.' She would not let a single drop fall. She had learned from the river that remembered everything. And the river had remembered war. It had remembered cruelty. It had remembered what it was like to fight back. She had won this battle. But the war was just beginning. And they would return with ten times more.
audio.bg_music: Epic battle Chinese orchestral, heavy drums and erhu, swelling strings, dark and intense 90 BPM
